from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Response
from fastapi.routing import APIRoute
import time
from typing import Callable

class MetricsTimingRoute(APIRoute):
    def get_route_handler(self) -> Callable:
        original_route_handler = super().get_route_handler()
        async def custom_handler(request: Request) -> Response:
            start_time = time.time()
            # Properly delegates to original_route_handler, ensuring dependencies are resolved
            response: Response = await original_route_handler(request)
            duration = time.time() - start_time
            response.headers["X-Response-Time"] = f"{duration:.4f}"
            return response
        return custom_handler

router = APIRouter(route_class=MetricsTimingRoute, prefix="/workspaces")

@router.get("/{workspace_id}/documents", dependencies=[Depends(verify_workspace_membership)])
async def get_workspace_documents(workspace_id: str):
    docs = await DocumentStore.fetch_by_workspace(workspace_id)
    return {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "documents": docs}
